reviews.text: Keith bol zrejme poriadny "zmrd", ale uziva si to i po dvoch porazkach a o to tvrdsie joke-y si moze teraz dovolit. :)  Veta "when I had my stroke" sa azda opakuje az prilis velakrat, ale nakoniec, to je ustredna tema jeho specialu. Pobavila prihodicka s Amy Schummer, ktora mu odkopla palicku :) Nasradost s pribehom z Popeye's Chicken bola autenticka. :) Prechody cez cestu v Londyne so 7-sekundovym odpocitavanim. :) "When every thing is going down, Viagra stands strong.""We almost lost you for some PUSSY!!!" "Son, are you gay, WTF?!" "Your medicine smells like HENNESSY . "Thank God for the white "Make America Great Again" nurses." Pohodovy story-tellingovy humor. Priemer.(19.07.2024)
